csv_project_name: Design Service for New Salt Shed
csv_scope_of_work: The Borough of Mercersburg, Franklin County, Pennsylvania, is issuing this request for proposals ( RFP ) to obtain written proposals for the construction of a new Salt Shed at 209 Oregon Street, Mercersburg, PA 17236 (the Project ). The work required will generally consist of all permitting and work necessary to design, engineer, and construct the new Salt Shed in accordance with the specifications set forth herein, including site preparation, foundation work, erection of the structure, and all related work. This RFP provides introductory information, describes the general scope of work, sets forth proposal requirements, and outlines the Borough s selection procedures.
